title: Open and inspect your files
summary: Open files right in Nest, and see everything Google kept about each one.

items.title: Open files in Nest
items.text: Click a picture, video, song, PDF or text file in Nest and it opens right in the page, like Google Drive. Use the arrow keys or swipe to move to the next file.

items.title: Info on every file
items.text: Press i (or choose Info) to see a file's details, including what Google kept when you moved it: who owned it, who it was shared with, the dates, and the original link. The loose .json files are tidied away.
